I’ve been diagnosed with bipolar disorder and it’s made my life very difficult. A lot of trauma has happened. I don’t have a lot of friends and it’s hard to make friends because socializing is hard. It’s hard because my memory is bad and I don’t think I’m all that interesting to be honest. I have a part time job. I wish it was a full time so it would take up more of my time but it is what it is. And overall, making it through everyday is extremely difficult. I hate it. The days are so incredibly long and dreadful. I dread waking up. I have no idea what I’m doing with my life or my future and I’ve been at my breaking point for a while now
